title: Parity layout document: one per screen and theme

occluded.description: How many otherwise exportable elements the exporter dropped because a modal, drawer or native video plane fully covers them (sanity count, 0 on screens without an overlay).

clockPinned.description: Device documents only: the app's own clock was pinned to the fixture instant for this capture.

role.description: text, heading, button, link, textbox, switch, select, image, video, container, tab, list, or an ARIA role; system = OS chrome (ignored).

colorGradient.description: Web only: the text is clipped to a gradient; color is the gradient's first stop.

volatile.description: Web documents: name from layout-volatile.json; text is not compared.

clock.description: Web documents: volatile unless the device declares clockPinned.

maskOnly.description: Web documents: never scored; the pixel scorer blanks the rect.
